metric_registry.insufficiency_detection_precision: true insufficient predictions / all insufficient predictions
metric_registry.insufficiency_detection_recall: true insufficient predictions / all labeled initial-insufficient cases
metric_registry.unnecessary_retry_rate: retries on labeled first-pass-sufficient cases / labeled first-pass-sufficient cases
metric_registry.critical_missing_detection_rate: detected critical insufficiency / labeled critical-missing cases
metric_registry.source_provenance_failure_detection: detected provenance failures / labeled provenance-failure cases
metric_registry.average_retrieval_attempts: sum retrieval attempts / all fixture cases
metric_registry.retry_latency_overhead_ms: mean retry planning plus attempt-1 evaluator time / retried cases
